notes.text: The page is headed Exercice 4.10.7 and explicitly resumes the hypotheses and notation of exercice 4.10.6. It adds condition (Et). No date or own page number appears; 11 is an archival corner number.
notes.basis: Observation: heading, opening paragraph, condition label, margins and lower-left corner.

notes.text: Condition (Et) says that the two written conditions involving u followed by v and u imply the condition involving v. The typed and pen relation signs are read by shape as epsilon forms. A cancelled m/M lies under the first underlined M.
notes.basis: Observation: (Et), both lines; crops 01–02. This is a description of the exercise, not a proof.

notes.text: Item 1 asks for the base-change functor to give a morphism of sites and be left exact. The words du topos are cancelled.
notes.basis: Observation: item 1 and its x-overtyped phrase; no mathematical verification undertaken.

notes.text: Item 2 asks for left exactness of Prol_X, the topos morphism g, its retraction relation with f, and a stated adjunction morphism. The first raised mark after S(X) is vee-shaped. The identity subscript in the retraction line is S(X), with no tilde. Mathematical expectations prompted attention to these marks but did not alter the ink.
notes.basis: Observation: item 2; crops 03–06. Formula-shape comparison only, not a proof check.

notes.text: Item 3 asks for failure of the conclusions without (Et), using the category of schemes with f.p.p.f. topology and the written class of flat, finitely presented morphisms. The source has singular les conclusion. The final fidèlement is cancelled. The final présentation contains an é/r overprint and two acute positions.
notes.basis: Observation: item 3, half b and crops 07–09; no claim that the counterexample has been proved.
